t: A two-wheel classroom robot car that a BBC micro:bit drives.
steps: Buy a Maqueen Plus V3 from DFRobot or a maker store, plus a BBC micro:bit V2.
Get four AA batteries or the rechargeable cell for your version.
Assemble the V3 kit with the printed guide in the box.
Open the free MakeCode editor in a web browser.
Search "dfrobot" in Extensions and add the Maqueen Plus V2 extension.
Place the I2C start block at the top of your program.
Try the motor example and download it to the micro:bit over USB.
Slide the micro:bit into the robot and watch it roll.
meta: Open Code. From $49.90. A few stores.
